name: Between the Prints
one_liner: A quarter-to-date nowcast from monthly dispatch releases, business updates and order-win filings. A user-accepted extraction spec per filer runs deterministically each month, and the result is compared to the model's quarter estimate as a 'required run-rate' bar, with order inflow summed onto the last stated order book for book-to-bill.
